Team — forwarding Lena's note. BrightBridge's CTO will be onsite and is asking for a 20–25 minute breakfast briefing at 08:30–08:55 PT on Nov 11 (we're currently at 11:00). Options I see:

1) Offer a shortened "exec briefing" at 08:30 that focuses strictly on model routing, latency/cost tradeoffs, and the proposed rollout constraints. This would be 20–25 minutes. We can follow up later with the 45-min deep dive for the product team (same day or later).
2) Keep the full demo at 11:00 and have Hannah run a 10–15 minute high-level intro with Rahul joining late — but that risks missing the CTO's availability window.

Who can cover the exec briefing at 08:30? I can present routing and SLAs but will need Marissa to lead commercial context and Hannah to handle the high-level infra notes. If we shorten to 25 minutes I recommend skipping the live multi-tenant walk and focusing on:
- 2-slide latency/cost summary
- 6-min live demo showing a fast inference path
- 6-min architecture/route policy explanation
- 6-min Q&A

Can Marissa confirm whether shortening is OK from a deal perspective (pricing/expectations) and whether we should still keep the 11:00 slot for a full technical session? Also tagging Karthik — want to make sure leadership is aware and approve a split schedule if needed.

Attachments: CTO-itinerary-Nov11.pdf (small)

Thanks — I can flip the calendar invite as soon as we confirm.

Mateo

--

All — good to shift the exec touchpoint earlier. Short briefing at 08:30 makes sense; it preserves goodwill with the CTO and keeps the full technical deep dive for the broader team. Two quick asks:

1) Keep the briefing tightly scoped and set expectations in the invite description so Rahul knows this is an "exec summary" not the full product deep dive.
2) Keep the 11:00 slot on the calendar as "Technical deep dive — full team" but mark it optional for Rahul. If they want to cancel the later session after the exec briefing, we can accommodate but let's leave it until they confirm.

Hannah — can you lead the short architecture summary? Mateo can handle live demo + routing. I’ll send an updated invite to Lena with both events (08:30 PT — Exec briefing, 11:00 PT — Full demo).
